newsitem.title: USA: Court approves Massimo's bankruptcy exit.
newsitem.headline: Court approves Massimo's bankruptcy exit.

text.p: Massimo da Milano Inc said U.S. Bankruptcy Court has approved the company's Plan of Reorganization for it to bring the wholesale bakery operation out of bankruptcy.
As part of its reorganization plan, Massimo's has closed all unprofitable locations and is expecting a profit for 1997.
Massimo's paid in excess of $150,000 of its $350,000 debt owed to the IRS, and paid $125,000 owed to the State of Texas, the company said.
Also, Massimo's has brought in new management, has entered into agreements with two large bakery customers, and is exploring new acquisitions.
Massimo's unaudited sales for the first quarter of 1997 were approximately $500,000, the company said.
Massimo's new marketing strategy which began this April should result in increased sales during the second half of 1997. In addition, Massimo's should have a NOL of approximately $4,000,000.
